Trump predicts oil price drop post-Iran conflict

US President Donald Trump claimed that oil prices would fall below $2 per gallon after a potential US victory in a conflict with Iran. This statement was made amidst escalating tensions and reciprocal threats between Tehran and Washington concerning energy assets. Brent crude futures were trading around $97.64 following Iran's threat of retaliatory strikes on energy facilities.
